content_sections.heading: RERA Bihar Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. RERA/Admn./05/2026/1323 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RERA Bihar notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Retired Judicial Officer below the age of 62 years, preferably retired recently; Has worked as a District Judge; No adverse reporting during service tenure; No disciplinary or criminal proceeding pending at the time of application; Sound health Experience: Has worked as a District Judge Age limit: Below 62 years (as on the last date of submission of the application) Other conditions: Must be a retired Judicial Officer who has worked as a District Judge No adverse reporting during service tenure No disciplinary or criminal proceeding pending at the time of application Must have sound health Affidavit declaring that the eligibility conditions are fulfilled must be submitted Desirable: Preferably retired recently

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for RERA Bihar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after 2400 Hrs. of 30 November 2026 shall not be considered Incomplete applications shall not be entertained

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay Minus Pension: last pay drawn reckoned for pay fixation and the entire pension deducted from the pay so fixed. Engagement up to the date the selected candidate attains 65 years of age or until further orders, whichever is earlier

rows.event: Last Date to Send Application by Email (up to 2400 Hrs.)

content_sections.heading: How Will RERA Bihar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications by the Authority Interview/Counselling/Interaction of shortlisted candidates All applications scrutinized by the Authority Only shortlisted candidates called for Interview/Counselling/Interaction Authority may obtain and consider ACRs/APARs of the last three years Names forwarded by the Law Department also invited for Interview/Counselling/Interaction Decision of the Authority on eligibility, shortlisting and selection is final

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae Details of posts held from appointment as Judicial Officer till retirement Details of judicial experience and important assignments handled Details of outstanding achievements, if any Affidavit declaring no disciplinary or criminal proceeding pending Copy of P.P.O. and copies of ACR of preceding last three years (Annexure-A)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RERA Bihar Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the format provided in Annexure-A. Attach CV, details of posts held, judicial experience, outstanding achievements and an affidavit. Email the application to [email protected] . Write the subject line: "Application for Adjudicating Officer". Send by 2400 Hrs. of 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must bring original documents, a copy of the PPO and the eligibility affidavit at interview Wrong or misleading information may lead to rejection of candidature and further action No correspondence on late applications will be entertained

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RERA Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RERA Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Adjudicating Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RERA Bihar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 62 years (as on the last date of submission of the application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Pay Minus Pension: last pay drawn reckoned for pay fixation, entire pension deducted.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired Judicial Officer who has worked as a District Judge, with no adverse reporting during service tenure, no disciplinary or criminal proceeding pending, and sound health.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired Judicial Officer who has worked as a District Judge. No adverse reporting during service tenure. No disciplinary or criminal proceeding pending at the time of application. Must have sound health.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after 2400 Hrs. of 30 November 2026 shall not be considered. Incomplete applications shall not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications by the Authority. Interview/Counselling/Interaction of shortlisted candidates. All applications scrutinized by the Authority. Only shortlisted candidates called for Interview/Counselling/Interaction.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement up to the date the selected candidate attains 65 years of age or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
